evidence.sourceVersion: Installed Elements Awoken 1.3.13.18; readable source commit 72d202d5157d91059cae1c117d25d142c8de9231 and installed assembly checked 2026-08-27
evidence.reason: These boss-drop accessories provide offensive, defensive, debuff-immunity, summon, or combat-mobility effects through custom UpdateAccessory logic and MyPlayer flags. The snapshot exports their acquisition paths but cannot represent those arbitrary or conditional effects in classEffects, so explicit all-class combat classification is required.

evidence.sourceVersion: Installed Elements Awoken 1.3.13.18; readable source commit 72d202d5157d91059cae1c117d25d142c8de9231 checked 2026-08-28
evidence.reason: Every new non-mediumcore character receives Mystic Gemstone from ModPlayer.AddStartingItems. Starting-item hooks are not represented by the current snapshot, so the gemstone must seed the otherwise circular legendary weapon recipe chains.

evidence.sourceVersion: Installed Elements Awoken 1.3.13.18; readable source commit 72d202d5157d91059cae1c117d25d142c8de9231 checked 2026-08-28
evidence.reason: The seven-step elemental boot line provides universal movement, flight, immunity, dash, and defensive effects through custom UpdateAccessory and wing hooks. Those arbitrary effects are not represented in snapshot classEffects, so explicit all-class accessory classification is required.

evidence.sourceVersion: Installed Elements Awoken 1.3.13.18; readable source commit 72d202d5157d91059cae1c117d25d142c8de9231 checked 2026-08-28
evidence.reason: Void Leviathan sets genVoidite on death, and MyWorld.GenVoidite creates underground Voidite ore veins. The snapshot records the tile drop but cannot represent this code-driven post-boss world-generation gate.

evidence.sourceVersion: Installed Elements Awoken 1.3.13.18; readable source commit 72d202d5157d91059cae1c117d25d142c8de9231 checked 2026-08-28
evidence.reason: These base materials drop from ordinary pre-Hardmode enemies through InMultipleConditionByMode wrappers containing only difficulty, biome, and non-statue checks. The snapshot preserves only the outer custom condition and loses its nested conditions, so their automatic paths remain unresolved even though their NPC sources are available from the start.

evidence.sourceVersion: Installed Elements Awoken 1.3.13.18; readable source commit 72d202d5157d91059cae1c117d25d142c8de9231 and snapshot checked 2026-08-28
evidence.reason: Elements Awoken offers alternative Elemental Forge recipes using ordinary corruption or crimson stone. The snapshot contains both recipes but has no world-resource source for either vanilla block, leaving the forge and all of its recipe chains unreachable.

The profile has no separate Goblin Army stage, while the boot chain requires Rocket Boots sold by the Goblin Tinkerer. Eye of Cthulhu is the nearest conservative stage after the event's ordinary health and Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart prerequisites can be met.
The profile has no separate Goblin Army stage. The Goblin Tinkerer sells the Tinkerer's Workshop, which is required by the vanilla Frostspark Boots chain feeding Desert Trailers.

Rainbow Dye is obtainable in Hardmode through the Dye Trader's Strange Plant reward chain. That exchange is absent from the snapshot, but the dye is a required ingredient for the final Boots of Nyan recipe.
